extracted.name: Easy Chicken and Biscuits
extracted.description: A creamy chicken and vegetable casserole is topped with flaky, golden biscuits.
ingredient_lines: 1 (10.75 ounce) can Campbell's® Condensed Cream of Celery Soup or Campbell's® Condensed 98% Fat Free Cream of Celery Soup
1 (10.75 ounce) can Campbell's® Condensed Cream of Potato Soup
instruction_lines: Mix soups, milk, thyme, black pepper, vegetables and chicken in 3-quart shallow baking dish.
Bake at 400 degrees F for 15 minutes. Stir.
Arrange cut biscuits over chicken mixture. Bake 15 minutes or until biscuits are golden.
